record.one_liner: iPayX Protocol is a FINTRAC-registered FX forensic audit service that scores FX transactions against live mid-market rates to flag hidden markup, spread and fees.
record.auth_notes: Static API keys sent as Authorization: Bearer. Prefixes ipx_live_ (production) and ipx_test_ (sandbox). No OAuth documented. Some MCP tools work unauthenticated (per-IP free limits).
record.access_notes: Homepage says API access is included in paid tiers. Pricing page lists Free (3 lifetime audits, no API listed), Credit Pack 100 at $99 one-time, Unlimited at $299/mo. It does not say which tier includes API keys. The MCP docs say keys are issued from the dashboard and list free-tool limits per key. The sandbox MCP test page and some MCP tools need no signup. The docs conflict on details (see blocker).
record.blocker: Narrow API (3 REST endpoints: POST /audit, GET /rates, POST /audit/document). The API-key tier is unclear, and the pricing page shows no explicit API plan. The vendor's own docs conflict on MCP endpoint (mcp.ipayx.ai vs a supabase.co URL) and on the price and limits of the forensic report ($297 vs $199). The REST base URL is on supabase.co. The rate limit quota is undocumented.
